seo.title: Services for fish vaccine manufacturers | AquaVant
seo.description: Advice on fish vaccine production, vaccination equipment and clinical trials, from specialists with more than 45 combined years in fish vaccines.

page.intro1: The adjuvant is our product. Around it, we help manufacturers with production, vaccination equipment and clinical trials.

services.heading1: One partner for the adjuvant and the know-how around it.
services.intro1: Our founders have spent their careers developing, producing and registering fish vaccines. We put that experience to work for our customers.
services.text1: Ready-to-use adjuvant formulations for injectable fish vaccines, developed for salmonids and tilapia. We work with you on formulation and testing until the adjuvant is qualified for your vaccine.
services.text2: Advice on producing fish vaccines and on the equipment you need to do it.
services.text3: Advice on equipment for giving vaccines to fish, by hand or with automatic machines.
services.item6: Matching equipment to vaccine and fish size
services.text4: Advice on planning and running vaccine trials, in the laboratory and in the field.
services.text5: Help with putting a new adjuvant into use, from the first formulation trials to routine production.

who.heading1: Built for the companies that make fish vaccines.
who.text1: Animal-health companies with established fish vaccine portfolios.
who.text2: Regional vaccine makers, including producers of autogenous (farm-specific) vaccines.
who.text3: Fish farmers and partners who want to understand vaccine options.

cta.heading1: Tell us what you are working on.
cta.text1: Whether you need an adjuvant, advice on production or help with a trial, we are happy to talk.
